import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;

    static long N;
    static ArrayList<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] temp = new int[15];
    static int result = 0;

    static long buildNumber(ArrayList<Integer> arr, int len) {
        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i)
            val = val * 10 + arr.get(i);
        return val;
    }

    static long computeRank(ArrayList<Integer> arr, int len) {
        long cnt = 0;
        for (int d = 1; d <= digits.size(); ++d) {
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(len, d); ++i) {
                int start = (i == 0) ? 1 : 0;
                for (int digit = start; digit < arr.get(i); ++digit) {
                    long low = 0, high = 0;
                    for (int p = 0; p < i; ++p)
                        low = high = low * 10 + arr.get(p);
                    low = high = low * 10 + digit;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p < d; ++p) {
                        low *= 10;
                        high = high * 10 + 9;
                    }
                    high = Math.min(high, N);
                    if (low <= high)
                        cnt += high - low + 1;
                }
            }
            if (d <= len) ++cnt;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static long evaluate(ArrayList<Integer> arr, int len) {
        return ((-buildNumber(arr, len) + computeRank(arr, len)) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
    }

    static int[] diff = new int[15];
    static ArrayList<Integer> queue1 = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<Integer> queue2 = new ArrayList<>();
    static long sumQueue2 = 0;

    static void generate(int pos, int end, ArrayList<Integer> q, long val) {
        if (pos == end) {
            for (int d = 0; d <= 9; ++d)
                q.add((int)((val + 1L * d * diff[pos]) % MOD1));
            return;
        }
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; ++d)
            generate(pos + 1, end, q, (val + 1L * d * diff[pos]) % MOD1);
    }

    static void applyUpdate(int len, int idx, int val) {
        temp[0] = digits.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < digits.size(); ++i)
            temp[i + 1] = digits.get(i);
        temp[idx + 1] = val;
        for (int p = idx + 2; p <= len; ++p)
            temp[p] = 0;
        ArrayList<Integer> arr = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int p = 1; p <= len; ++p)
            arr.add(temp[p]);
        long baseVal = evaluate(arr, len);
        for (int p = idx + 2; p <= len; ++p) {
            temp[p] = 1;
            ArrayList<Integer> arr2 = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 1; i <= len; ++i)
                arr2.add(temp[i]);
            diff[p] = (int)((evaluate(arr2, len) + MOD1 - baseVal) % MOD1);
            temp[p] = 0;
        }
        if (len - idx == 0) {
            result = (result + (int)(baseVal % MOD2)) % (int)MOD2;
            return;
        }
        if (len - idx == 1) {
            for (int d = 0; d <= 9; ++d)
                result = (result + (int)((baseVal + 1L * d * diff[len]) % MOD1)) % (int)MOD2;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (len + idx) / 2;
        queue1.clear();
        queue2.clear();
        generate(idx + 1, mid, queue1, baseVal);
        generate(mid + 1, len, queue2, 0);
        Collections.sort(queue2);
        sumQueue2 = 0;
        for (int x : queue2)
            sumQueue2 = (sumQueue2 + x) % MOD2;
        for (int x : queue1) {
            int pos = Collections.binarySearch(queue2, (int)(MOD1 - x));
            if (pos < 0) pos = -pos - 1;
            result = (result + (int)(sumQueue2 + 1L * queue2.size() * x)) % (int)MOD2;
            result = (result + (int)(1L * (queue2.size() - pos) * (MOD2 - MOD1))) % (int)MOD2;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        while (N > 0) {
            digits.add((int)(N % 10));
            N /= 10;
        }
        Collections.reverse(digits);
        N = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < digits.size(); ++i)
            N = N * 10 + digits.get(i);
        for (int len = 1; len <= digits.size(); ++len) {
            for (int pos = 0; pos < len; ++pos) {
                int low = (pos == 0) ? 1 : 0;
                int high = (len == digits.size()) ? digits.get(pos) - 1 : 9;
                for (int d = low; d <= high; ++d) {
                    if (d != digits.get(pos))
                        applyUpdate(len, pos, d);
                }
            }
            ArrayList<Integer> arr = new ArrayList<>(digits.subList(0, len));
            result = (result + (int)(evaluate(arr, len) % MOD2)) % (int)MOD2;
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
